verdict.rationale: Cursor documents running many agents in parallel, each in an isolated worktree or cloud VM, and agents attach review artifacts to their PRs. That covers the parallel-attempts half of the story. Nothing documents launching several attempts at the same task and comparing them side by side to pick a winner. missing for 10: documented multi-attempt or best-of-N runs on a single task, a side-by-side comparison or selection UI, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run several task attempts in parallel and compare results before choosing one

citations.quote: Use worktrees when you want to start several agents on the same repo without conflicts
You can run as many agents as you want in parallel
Each task gets its own files, dependencies, and changes while your main checkout stays untouched.
These artifacts are attached to the PR so you can quickly validate changes without checking out the branch locally.
